**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **No Customer MFN exists.** § 12.3 states affirmatively that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," and no disclosure, benchmarking, or right-to-match mechanic appears anywhere in the document.
- **Pricing sections confirmed clean.** § 7.1 (Fees fixed during initial term; no unstated charges) and § 8.3 (renewal increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%) impose obligations on Vendor and operate in our favour — MFN-style protection for us, which the playbook welcomes.
- **No redline proposed**, consistent with the rule's direction guidance not to flag terms that benefit our party.
